name: Ben Chi
photoAlt: A hand-drawn illustration of Ben Chi
bio: I am at Zhejiang University. My research focuses on smart cities and human mobility.
My work explores how large language models and generative agents can help us understand and predict movement in cities, from individual travel patterns to city-wide mobility demand.
